summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue but may introduce unintended behavior due to its handling of dimensions.

issues.description: The patch assumes that if an argument is dimensionless, its dimension should be set to Dimension(1). This may lead to incorrect behavior for other functions or expressions where the dimension should not be simplified to Dimension(1).
The patch does not include additional tests to verify that the change does not introduce regressions or affect other parts of the codebase.
